issues.issue: Whether the claimant's identity and credibility are established
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says his family was targeted by Al-Shabaab for recruitment and he fled to Kenya in 2008.
issues.result_text: Identity accepted through aunt's testimony and diploma; claimant testified straightforwardly and is credible.

issues.issue: Whether an internal flight alternative exists in Puntland
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says he cannot live safely in Puntland because he lacks local knowledge and clan affiliations there.
issues.result_text: Claimant would be safe in Bosaso, Puntland through his Darod clan; moving there is not objectively unreasonable.
